title: Payment Arrangements Rate Sheet: Past-Due Floors, Arranged Amount Ceilings and Offer Seasons
content:
Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements) — amount limits and offer seasons by tier.

| Tier | Smallest past-due amount for which an offer is made | Largest amount that may be arranged after the down payment | First offer day each year | Last offer day |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Deferred Payment Agreement | $50.00 | $1500.00 | January 1 | December 31 |
| Extended Hardship Payment Agreement | $50.00 | $2500.00 | January 1 | December 31 |
| Winter Protection Payment Agreement | $50.00 | $2500.00 | November 1 | March 31 |
| Medical Certificate Payment Agreement | $50.00 | $2500.00 | January 1 | December 31 |
| Agricultural Harvest Payment Agreement | $250.00 | $15000.00 | April 1 | August 31 |
| Commercial Installment Agreement | $100.00 | $10000.00 | January 1 | December 31 |

**Definitions used on this sheet**

- The *smallest past-due amount* is the floor, in US dollars, below which the tier is not offered.
- The *largest amount that may be arranged* is the ceiling, in US dollars, on the amount left to spread after the down payment.
- The *offer season* runs from the first offer day through the last offer day, both days included, in each calendar year. A season whose first day falls later in the calendar than its last day crosses the new year: it runs from the first day through December 31 and from January 1 through the last day. On this sheet only the Winter Protection Payment Agreement season crosses the new year.

**Season boundaries (hypothetical dates)**

| Tier | Day inside the season | Day outside the season |
|---|---|---|
| Winter Protection Payment Agreement | November 1; January 15; March 31 | October 31; April 1 |
| Agricultural Harvest Payment Agreement | April 1; August 31 | March 31; September 1 |
| Standard, Extended Hardship, Medical Certificate and Commercial Installment tiers | every day of the year | none |

**Amount limits (hypothetical figures)**

- A past-due amount of $49.99 is below the $50.00 floor of the Standard Deferred Payment Agreement; $50.00 meets it.
- On the Agricultural Harvest Payment Agreement a past-due amount of $249.99 is below the $250.00 floor; $250.00 meets it.
- On the Commercial Installment Agreement, an amount of $10000.00 left after the down payment is within the ceiling; $10000.01 exceeds it.
